Description: State in which the AHJ is located.
AHJ for permitting and inspection. Only AHJs where project-level data for at least 10 projects were provided are included. AHJ names are those used by the U.S. Census Bureau.
Geography ID code generated from the U.S. Census Bureau summary-level state, county, and place codes, used for geographic information system (GIS) mapping.
Name of the electric service provider.
U.S. Energy Information Administration identification number for the electric service provider.

The SolSmart program awards AHJs for improvements to local permitting, inspection, planning, zoning, government operations, community engagement, and/or market development. AHJs are awarded at the bronze, silver, gold, or platinum level. More information at https://solsmart.org/.
Potential Values/Definitions: Bronze, silver, gold, platinum = SolSmart award level; No = not an awardee; NA = not reported

Description: Whether the AHJ currently accepts permit submissions through an online portal or email.
Potential Values/Definitions: Yes = online portal or email submissions accepted; No = online submissions not accepted; NA = not reported

Description: Flag for whether the AHJ has an online instant permitting system for standard residential projects (e.g., SolarAPP+).
Potential Values/Definitions: No = instant permitting unavailable; Yes (SolarAPP+), Yes (Symbium), Yes (other), or Yes (only DORA state-level permit) = available through the named system or pathway; NA = not reported

Variable Descriptions: Structural Stamp From Professional Engineer Required
Description: Whether the AHJ requires a structural stamp from a professional engineer.
Potential Values/Definitions: Always = required for applicable projects; sometimes = required conditionally; never = not required; unknown/NA = not reported

Variable Descriptions: Electrical Stamp From Licensed Electrician Required
Description: Whether the AHJ requires an electrical stamp from a licensed electrician.
Potential Values/Definitions: Always = required for applicable projects; sometimes = required conditionally; never = not required; unknown/NA = not reported

Description: Whether third-party permitting or permit review is available.
Potential Values/Definitions: Yes = third-party permitting or review is available; sometimes = available for some review types or circumstances; No = unavailable; NA = not reported

Description: Median cost for a residential permit. Missing data labeled NA.
Potential Values/Definitions: Numeric dollar amount = median residential permit cost; NA = not reported

Description: Number of different inspection types required by the AHJ (e.g., building, electrical, fire, rough-in). Missing data labeled NA.
Potential Values/Definitions: Numeric count = number of required inspection types; NA = not reported

Description: Flag (Yes/No/NA) for whether a rough-in (partially installed) inspection is required.
Potential Values/Definitions: Yes = required; No = not required; NA = not reported

Description: Flag (Yes/No/NA) for whether the AHJ offers virtual/remote inspections.
Potential Values/Definitions: Yes = available; No = unavailable; NA = not reported

Description: Whether a fire department review is required.
Potential Values/Definitions: Yes = required; No = not required; Not for Resi = not applicable to residential projects; NA = not reported
